stage: Pre-build design for a launch at 50k online drivers, money involved

issues.title: GPS write volume will overwhelm the shared Postgres primary
issues.match_hint: 50k drivers every 2s = ~25k row UPDATEs + 25k INSERTs per second on the single primary that every service shares; takes down unrelated paths.

issues.title: Location history kept forever (unbounded growth + PII without retention)
issues.match_hint: ~2 billion rows/day with no deletion plan; precise location history is personal data.

issues.title: Single Matcher instance with a 4-minute cold start, restarted on every deploy
issues.match_hint: Core path (matching) is down for several minutes on every deploy or crash; no standby; single instance used as the concurrency control.

issues.title: Offer acceptance is not conditional (late accepts double-assign)
issues.match_hint: After a 15s timeout the trip is re-offered, but the accept UPDATE has no status/offer check, so a late accept overwrites or two drivers are both told they have the ride.

issues.title: Charge retries without an idempotency key (double charge)
issues.match_hint: A timeout may mean the charge succeeded; retrying POST /charges up to 3 times can charge the rider several times.

issues.title: Trip marked completed whether or not payment succeeded
issues.match_hint: No payment-failed state, dunning or reconciliation; failures after retries are undefined.

issues.title: Offers delivered only via one push provider
issues.match_hint: A push outage stops all matching; no in-app channel or fallback.

issues.title: No monitoring until after launch
issues.match_hint: Launching a real-time money system with logs only; no SLO/alerts for the 3s match target.

issues.title: Nightly pg_dump only: 24h RPO, no PITR, restore untested
issues.match_hint: Up to a day of trips and payments lost; dumping a write-heavy primary nightly is slow and heavy.

issues.title: Synchronous HTTP chains on a shared database (cascading failure)
issues.match_hint: All services on one primary and synchronous calls; one slow component stalls the rest.

issues.title: Matcher index refreshed every 5s from the DB (stale availability, reload load)
issues.match_hint: Drivers just assigned still look available for up to 5s; full reloads every 5s at 50k drivers.

issues.title: Surge job runs inside each of the 4 Trips instances
issues.match_hint: An in-process scheduled job in a 4-instance service runs 4x per minute and races on the Redis value.

bonus: Matcher single instance used as the mutual-exclusion mechanism instead of a DB-level claim on the driver
Driver availability not claimed atomically (same driver offered two trips)
Single region accepted for launch but no documented DR plan
Notifier only 2 instances with no queue/backpressure
Fare dispute evidence relies on location history: define retention by purpose
